decisions.statement: A declared server switched off in the harness is switched back on.
A server switched off that nothing declares is left switched off.
Only the project whose real path is the launch directory is touched.
A configuration this module cannot read is left alone rather than rewritten.
Nothing to clear is no plan rather than a plan that changes nothing.
A configuration is rewritten keeping whether that configuration ended in a newline.

definition: a harness setting that switched a declared tool server off, undone before launch
